Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.lifecycle

Interface LifecycleListener

public interface LifecycleListener
Observer callback for model deployment lifecycle events, useful for wiring up logging, metrics, or alerting around deployments without changing LifecycleManager itself.

All methods have empty default implementations, so listeners only need to override the events they care about.

Since:
0.1.0
